objectives: By the end of the semester, each student will be in a position to understand how historical analogies operate as both cognitive shortcuts and rhetorical tools for framing foreign policy issues.

By the end of the semester, each student will be in a position to explain how media and political leaders use historical analogies to shape public perceptions and support for foreign policy initiatives.
